items.t: West Vancouver real estate market stats

faq.a: A small District of West Vancouver neighbourhood at the District's east edge — the detached-house streets around Burley Drive, Kings Avenue and Mathers Avenue, below the British Properties and west of the Capilano River, with École Cedardale, Cedardale Park and Burley Drive Park inside it; the District uses the name on its neighbourhood context and municipal maps, but publishes no street-by-street boundaries for it.

faq.q: Which school is located in Cedardale?
faq.a: École Cedardale (K–7), 595 Burley Drive — a single-track French Immersion school and authorized IB World School offering the IB Primary Years Programme in French Immersion; admission is by lottery, and the English catchment school for a given address must be checked in the SD45 locator.

faq.q: How do you get around from Cedardale?
faq.a: Route 251 runs on Cedardale's own streets (Kings Avenue, Burley Drive, Mathers Avenue) to Park Royal Exchange, where the R2 RapidBus now runs one-seat to Metrotown and route 250 runs on Marine Drive to downtown Vancouver via the Lions Gate Bridge; by car, Taylor Way reaches Highway 1 directly.

faq.q: Can Jared show me homes in Cedardale?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.
